name: Flare
source:
She will not let anyone touch what is deep in her heart. A queen who gives the impression of being somewhat cold. She presides over power and fear.

She sometimes beheads her loyal subjects without hesitation. She is also feared for her ruthlessness.

But the truth is...  She is also a queen who never makes the mistake of mistaking what her priorities really are.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
